flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: The membership renews automatically for successive 12-month terms at the then-current rate without a fresh signature, and even a suspended, frozen or medically held membership keeps renewing on the original schedule.

flags.sourceSentence: Notice delivered after that day takes effect at the end of the term that follows, and the dues for the intervening term remain payable in full.
flags.consequence: Missing the 3-day cancellation window commits the signer to another full 12-month term at the then-current rate, which may be higher, and late notice only takes effect after that following term ends, with its dues payable in full.

flags.sourceSentence: A membership that has been suspended, frozen or placed on medical hold continues to renew on its original schedule.
flags.consequence: The membership keeps renewing on its original schedule even while suspended, frozen or on medical hold, so the signer can owe dues for a full term during which they cannot or do not use the facility.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the fees, rules, hours, classes and any term of the agreement at any time, with the change applying from the date it is posted, and the signer is treated as accepting it merely by continuing to use the facility — with no cap on increases and no right to cancel without penalty stated in the clause.

flags.sourceSentence: Your continued use of any facility after an amended version is posted is your acceptance of it.
flags.consequence: The signer is treated as having accepted any posted amendment simply by continuing to use the facility, so changes can bind them without any signature or affirmative consent.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: The signer must reimburse Meridian, defend it, and cover its legal fees for third-party claims arising from their use of the facilities, their conduct, their guests' conduct, or any service they provide to another member, with the amount open-ended and Meridian choosing the lawyer and controlling settlement.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after their Program candidacy ends, the signer cannot teach, coach or deliver fitness or personal training — as employee, contractor or on their own account — within 15 miles of any Meridian location where they taught or trained, and cannot solicit Meridian members or candidates for outside instruction, which could block their livelihood in the area.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and to bring or join a class, collective or representative action against Meridian; disputes go to a single arbitrator whose award is final, with only a 30-day window after first accepting the agreement to opt out in writing.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may adjust dues once in any twelve (12) month period by the greater of six percent (6%)  or the increase in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers over the preceding twelve months, on thirty (30) days notice to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Meridian can raise dues once every 12 months by the greater of 6% or CPI on 30 days' email notice, with no right to cancel stated in the clause, so the signer could face a compounding increase each year while still owing the balance of the term.

flags.sourceSentence: Dues not received within ten (10) days of the draw date incur the late charge set out in the Schedule of Fees then in effect, which is posted at the Member Services desk and on the Meridian website and forms part of this Agreement.
flags.consequence: Late dues trigger a late charge whose amount is not stated in the agreement but set in a Schedule of Fees posted at the desk and online, so the signer cannot see the figure in the document itself, and similar open-ended charges apply for returned payments, keycard replacement and account reinstatement.

flags.sourceSentence: Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition.
flags.consequence: Program tuition renews automatically each year at the then-current rate unless the signer gives written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary date; missing that window commits them to another year of tuition at a rate they may not know in advance.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: The signer is responsible for every entry made with their keycard or account, so unauthorised use of a lost or stolen keycard or account could result in charges or rule-violation consequences attributed to them.

flags.sourceSentence: You agree to keep the contact details, billing details and emergency contact on your account current, and to tell Member Services in writing of any change within ten (10) days.
flags.consequence: The signer must keep account contact, billing and emergency contact details current and report any change in writing within 10 days, on pain of whatever consequences follow from missed notices, which are sent to the address on file.

flags.sourceSentence: You authorise Meridian to draw all dues, tuition and charges from the payment method on your account until this Agreement has ended and your balance is nil.
flags.consequence: The signer authorises Meridian to keep drawing all dues, tuition and charges from their payment method until the agreement has ended and the balance is nil, so charges continue automatically after they stop using the facilities unless the agreement is properly ended.

flags.sourceSentence: You will return the coaching manual and any Meridian teaching materials in your possession within fourteen (14) days of the end of your candidacy.
flags.consequence: The signer must return the coaching manual and all Meridian teaching materials within 14 days of the end of their candidacy, on top of the 12-month non-compete that follows candidacy.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
flags.consequence: If the signer ends the licence early, they lose the whole remaining season's fee: the $45 is not refunded in proportion to the months left, even though the Association must refund proportionally when it ends the licence. On a $45 fee the amount is small and bounded.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Any equipment or belongings the signer leaves on the plot after 15 December 2027 — canes, netting, frames or other items — becomes the Association's property to keep or throw away, so the signer loses those items and any money spent on them.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Northwind can raise the signer's plan fee with 30 days' email notice, with no cap on the increase and no stated right to cancel without paying the higher rate; the signer's only stated alternative is to keep paying the revised fee or stop using the service.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: If the signer misses the 30-day pre-anniversary cancellation deadline, the annual plan automatically extends for a further twelve months at the fee then in effect, committing them to another year of payments without a fresh signature.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: Northwind can change any term of the agreement — including the pricing page and Fee Schedule referenced for charges — at any time, and the changes take effect merely by being posted, with the signer deemed to have accepted them by continuing to use the service; the clause names no limits on what can be changed.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: Northwind's total liability for all claims — including lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — is capped at what the signer paid for the single Billing Period in which the claim arose, so a month of destroyed design work could be compensated by as little as one month's fee.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay for Northwind's defence of any third-party claim connected to content they uploaded, exported or published — including copyright, trade mark or privacy claims — an obligation with no stated dollar cap that could exceed anything the signer paid for the service.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to bring disputes in court (except small claims) or as part of a class or collective action; any dispute, however serious, must go to individual binding arbitration with a final award, so the signer cannot pool claims with other affected users.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: A missed or failed payment (including an expired card, which is treated as a failed collection) accrues interest at 1.5% per month until paid, and a suspended account can be restarted only on payment of a reactivation charge whose amount is set in a Fee Schedule the signer cannot see in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: Where availability in a calendar month falls below that figure, your remedy is the service credit set out in the Service Credit Policy and nothing further.
flags.consequence: If service quality drops, the signer's only remedy is the service credit described in a separate Service Credit Policy — even for losses like lost work or a failed export — with no refund or other compensation stated.

flags.sourceSentence: You may not share your credentials with anyone else, and an account we believe is being used by more than one person may be suspended while we ask you about it.
flags.consequence: The signer's account can be suspended on Northwind's belief alone that more than one person is using it, cutting off access to the editor, asset library and stored work while Northwind investigates, with no stated notice or time limit.

flags.sourceSentence: Your subscription continues from one Billing Period into the next without further action by either of us, and we bill the plan fee then in effect on the first day of each new Billing Period.
flags.consequence: The subscription rolls into the next Billing Period automatically and the signer is billed the then-current plan fee unless they cancel by the day before the period ends; the agreement does not end on its own.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, benefit plan, or term of employment described in the offer — including compensation-related terms — at any time without the signer's agreement, with the intranet version taking effect from its publication date.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends — even if Ardent ends it — the signer cannot work in a similar role for any business in the 'Restricted Field' defined in Exhibit B, which the signer has not been given, and cannot solicit Ardent employees or approach Ardent customers, distributors or contract manufacturers they dealt with.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must reimburse Ardent for any claim, loss, liability or expense, including attorney fees, arising from an alleged breach of the confidentiality or post-termination sections, or from a former employer's claim that the new job breaches an obligation owed to that employer — an open-ended amount.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to take employment disputes — including statutory claims — to court or a jury, and cannot join a class, collective or representative action; all claims must go to individual binding arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: Bonus awards are discretionary in amount and in whether they are made at all, and an award is paid only if you are employed on the payment date.
flags.consequence: The discretionary bonus is paid only if the signer is still employed on the payment date, so a bonus earned through a year of work can be withheld entirely if employment ends just before payment, and the amount and even whether it is paid are fully at Ardent's discretion.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: If the signer resigns or is terminated for cause within 12 months of the 4 May 2026 start date, the entire $15,000 signing payment must be repaid within 30 days of their last working day, even though it was paid as a one-time sum.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: The Operator's liability for loss of or damage to stored property, including loss caused by the Operator's own negligence, is capped at $5,000, so the occupant bears any loss above that amount unless they declared a higher value and paid the value protection fee.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim arising out of the occupant's use of the unit, the stored property, or the acts of anyone the occupant allows on the premises, including attorney fees, with no cap and no exclusion for claims caused by the Operator's own conduct.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The Operator can unilaterally change the gate hours, the posted rules, and the terms of this Agreement itself by posting notice at the facility and emailing the occupant, with the changed version binding from the first day of the following month; there is no cap on what can be changed and no stated right to exit without penalty in response.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: Unpaid rent or any charge gives the Operator a lien on all property in the unit, allowing it to deny the occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the required notice period sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may increase the monthly rent on not less than thirty (30) days written notice to the Occupant, and the increased rent is due on the first rent day falling after the notice period ends.
flags.consequence: The Operator can raise the monthly rent on 30 days' written notice, with no cap on the increase and no stated right for the occupant to end the agreement without penalty in response; the occupant either pays the new rate or must use the ordinary termination notice.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: Late-payment charges are set in a Schedule of Charges the occupant is not given in this document, and each further notice about an unpaid balance adds another administration charge, so fees can accumulate on an open-ended per-notice basis.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant is required to keep insurance on the stored property for its full value and to produce evidence of it on request.
flags.consequence: The occupant must keep insurance on the stored property for its full value and produce evidence on request; failing that, the occupant carries the entire risk of loss, and the agreement does not state what happens if evidence is not produced (for example whether the Operator can charge a fee or treat it as a default).

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: The agreement renews automatically month to month with no fresh signature, and it does not end on its own; the occupant must give written notice at least ten days before the end of a month to stop owing rent.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may apply any payment received to the oldest amount outstanding.
flags.consequence: The Operator can apply any payment received to the oldest amount outstanding, which means a partial payment cannot be directed by the occupant to current rent and could leave the current month technically unpaid, feeding into the late-charge and lien provisions.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may enter the unit to inspect it, to repair the premises, or where the Operator reasonably believes the contents present a danger, and will leave notice of the entry in or on the unit.
flags.consequence: The Operator can enter the occupant's unit to inspect it, to repair the premises, or where it reasonably believes the contents present a danger, leaving only a notice of entry in or on the unit afterwards; there is no advance notice requirement and no limit on inspection frequency.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent already paid for the month in which the Occupant moves out is not refunded.
flags.consequence: Rent already paid for the month in which the occupant moves out is not refunded, so the occupant loses the rent for the unused remainder of that month even if they leave early in the month.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: A twelve-month promotional plan automatically renews for another twelve-month term at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate unless the signer tells Cascade to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term, committing them to a full year at a higher, unstated rate.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: If the signer cancels a promotional plan before the end of its term, the entire unpaid device instalment balance becomes due in full on the next bill, even though the service plan itself has ended.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term of the agreement, any charge, and any feature of the rate plan, and the change takes effect on a date Cascade states in a notice that can arrive on a bill, by device message, or by email. The clause names no cap on increases and no right to leave without penalty except the separate 30-day window for material increases to the monthly recurring charge.

flags.sourceSentence: Continuing to use the service after the effective date of a change accepts the change.
flags.consequence: The signer is treated as accepting any change Cascade makes simply by continuing to use the service after the change's effective date, without signing anything or expressly agreeing.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover any claim, loss or expense, including legal fees, arising from their use of the service, anything sent from or stored on their device, use of the line by anyone they allow to use it, and any charge incurred on the account — an open-ended obligation with no cap.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, and must resolve any dispute through individual binding arbitration, which removes court and group-action routes for serious problems.

flags.sourceSentence: Your bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge, neither of which is a tax or a charge required by any government, and Cascade may introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change ﬁrst appears.
flags.consequence: The bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge that are not government-required, and Cascade can introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given in the bill where the change first appears, so these amounts can grow with no stated cap.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: An unpaid balance incurs a late charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance, applied again each bill period until paid, so the charge compounds on a continuing balance; a restored line also incurs a restoral charge whose amount is set in the Rate and Charge Guide, which was not provided.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim about the service, a device, or the agreement is capped at the service charges for the affected line for the single bill period in which the claim arose, and it is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or indirect or consequential loss, so recovery for a serious problem could be very small relative to the harm.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: When the signer cancels, charges continue to the end of the bill period and the partial period is not prorated, so they pay for days of service they will not use.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week Programme at any point for any reason on one week's written notice, cutting off the remaining stipend weeks with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can change the Handbook, the assessments, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement itself at any time, and the change takes effect simply by emailing it — the Analyst has no right to agree, and no stated cap on what can change.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the Programme ends, the Analyst cannot take any engagement — paid or unpaid, including internships — with any firm on a Restricted List they may not fully see in advance, and cannot approach clients they worked on, which could block future work.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must cover any claim, loss or expense the Firm incurs — including legal costs — from a breach of the confidentiality or post-programme sections, or from anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or its clients, with no cap on the amount.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and to bring or join a class or collective action, and must resolve any dispute alone in individual arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: A late instalment on the housing advance accrues a late charge, in an amount set in the Programme Handbook the signer has not seen, that continues until the advance is fully repaid.

flags.sourceSentence: This obligation has no end date.
flags.consequence: The confidentiality obligation never expires, so the Analyst could face consequences indefinitely for disclosing or retaining anything seen during the Programme.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: The Analyst is charged the replacement cost of any issued item — laptop, security token or building pass — in an amount set in the Programme Handbook they have not seen, if it is not returned within five working days.

flags.sourceSentence: After the third lesson no refund is made.
flags.consequence: If the place is given up after the third lesson, the signer loses the entire $120 fee for the remaining lessons, even if the child attends none of them.

flags.sourceSentence: A place given up later than that, and before the third lesson, is refunded at half the fee.
flags.consequence: If the place is given up after the seven-day window but before the third lesson, the signer forfeits half the fee ($60) for lessons the child will not attend.
